content_sections.heading: ACTREC Scientific Assistant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ACTREC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years Age relaxation may be relaxed on experience basis. content_sections.heading: ACTREC Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ACTREC Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the ACTREC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the ACTREC recruitment is Scientific Assistant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Scientific Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview date for the Scientific Assistant post is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: The required qualifications include M.Sc. in Statistics, IT, Computer Science, Public Health, Biotechnology, or Life Science. M. Tech/B. Tech in Biotechnology is also accepted.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any experience required for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: One year of experience in Cancer registry is desirable for the Scientific Assistant post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Scientific Assistant post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is between Rs. 28,450 to Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the ACTREC Scientific Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an MCQ Examination, a Written Interview, and a final Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.
